items.body_html: every actor-emitted envelope must claim a role from L1 on — like expected_version at L0b, the snapshot field becomes required when introduced
role authority and the capability check both run before the atomic commit — a rejected emit never changes state
absent an explicit profile, allowed(role, step) = the step's transitions for its own role — so not_authorized is dormant until a restriction or multi-role action enters the same profile
